scope: control-only immutable source payload plus separate mode-editable state, exact source-record refs and executable failure-byte invariance

proposed_work_order.fixed_operation_semantics: historical name; only editable state changes and exactly one existing fault.mode changes; immutable source payload/ref/record/axes/identities never change
proposed_work_order.future_mapping: T1 only, fresh same-candidate source-backed lossless mapping into CandidateStatePackageV5Next

source_record_contract.record_ref_rule: source record ref URI/version/hash must byte-match source record record_uri/record_version/source_record_hash
source_record_contract.slot_absence_hash: H(canonical(domain, slot_kind, status=typed_absent, candidate_ref, reason)) excluding absence_content_hash

state_contract.absent_rule: source_payload_ref/editable_body/initial_source_content_hash nothing; absence reason/hash present; contract_admission terminal_deferred; no edit
state_contract.state_absence_hash: H(canonical(domain, key, state_status=typed_absent, terminal_deferred admission, typed physical resolution, absence_reason, source/edit/hash nothing, ZERO_DIGEST last operation, typed empty history)) excluding absence_content_hash
state_contract.physical_resolution_type: G3ControlPhysicalResolutionV1(status, reason, evidence_ref), status unknown|terminal_deferred; terminal_deferred requires typed non-empty reason

operation_contract.operation_hash_recipe: H(canonical(operation_id, operation_kind, key, fault_id, expected_prior_mode, resulting_mode, previous_state_hash, expected_prior_source_content_hash, prior_editable_body_hash, replacement_editable_body_hash, source_record_ref, source_payload_ref)) excluding operation_hash and resulting_state_hash
operation_contract.resulting_state_hash_recipe: H(canonical(key, state_status, source_payload_ref, editable_body_after, initial_source_content_hash, initial_state_hash, previous_state_hash, prior_operation_hashes_in_order, operation_hash, last_operation_hash, admission, typed physical resolution))
operation_contract.duplicate_and_chain_rule: operation_id, operation_hash and fault_id+previous_state_hash globally unique; previous_state_hash equals prior result; tuple order immutable

five_hash_layers: source_record_hash over record URI/version and all complete slots; own/downstream hashes excluded
source_content_hash over key, complete parent binding/ref/hash, actual child contract ref/hash, source URI/version, complete source_record_ref and body; own hash excluded
initial_state_hash over state status, source ref/body/hash or typed-absent marker, admission, typed physical resolution, ZERO_DIGEST operation and typed empty history; status included and frozen

operation_hash over full operation identity including prior and replacement editable body hashes, fault ID, before/after mode, previous state hash and exact source-record/source-payload refs; operation/result hashes excluded

resulting_state_hash over state identity, immutable source ref, editable body, initial hashes, previous state, prior operation hashes, new operation hash and last-operation hash; no resulting hash input

zero_rules.typed_absent: source/edit/hash fields nothing, typed absence digest, typed empty history, last_operation_hash=ZERO_DIGEST, current==initial, no edit

required: result.state===old_state when runtime identity check is meaningful; otherwise serialized byte equality is mandatory
canonical_failure_check.scope: every failure path including stale, forged, foreign, malformed, duplicate, reordered, non-mode, multi-fault, absent and forbidden operation

review_requirement: different Luna independently reviews R5 before implementation dispatch
